title: Case: Returned parcel has reached the carrier depot but not the merchant warehouse
context: The return is in carrier transit, with no merchant receipt. Tracing should end in a warehouse confirmation rather than an inferred refund.
initial_request: My return has been sitting at the depot. Could you trace it to the merchant? I need to know when they actually have it.

events.body: RT-8602 last scan: return depot, 2027-03-06 07:40 UTC. No merchant receiving scan is visible. The carrier still holds the return.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Returns trace team, Glimmerton Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier's returns team to trace the parcel to the merchant.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Glimmerton Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier's returns team to trace the parcel to the merchant. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Merchant physical receipt does not establish accepted condition, refund approval or payment.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Please trace RT-8602 through to merchant receipt. Ask the merchant receiving team to confirm physical acceptance rather than use a departure scan as proof.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-034: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
